verdict.summary: The dispatch-only sccache experiment is correctly isolated from push, pull_request, and merge_group runs by exact per-step guards and an off-by-default choice input. The production cargo invocation remains unchanged, measurements are clearly labeled as experimental upper-bound data, and the research note avoids claiming an unmeasured result. The structural tests are non-vacuous and directly pin both load-bearing controls: every current sccache-enabling step must use the exact dispatch guard, and the input must default to the quoted string "off". No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect requiring changes was found in the supplied diff.
